_README: TV auto-updater configuration template. Copy to 'config.json' (the blueprint installer renders /etc/homelab/tv-autoupdater.json) and customize for your home network.

_GUIDE.subnet_prefix: First 3 octets of your local LAN (e.g. '192.168.1' or '10.0.0'). Used by the ARP/ADB dynamic IP resolver.
_GUIDE.dhcp_scan_range: [start_host, end_host] range to sweep when a TV's IP changes under DHCP lease renewals.
_GUIDE.how_to_find_model: Run 'adb -s <TV_IP>:5555 shell getprop ro.product.model' or 'getprop ro.product.device' to find your TV identifier.
_GUIDE.how_to_enable_adb: On your Android TV, go to Settings -> Device Preferences -> About -> Click 'Build' 7 times. Then go to Developer Options -> Enable 'USB / Network Debugging'.
_GUIDE.apk_signatures: Per package: SHA-256 fingerprints of the signing certificates allowed for that app. Downloads and installs with any other key are refused. Get a fingerprint with: python3 tv_updater.py --print-signature file.apk
_GUIDE.allow_unpinned_apps: false (default): refuse apps that have no pin above. Manual drops in incoming_apks/ are always allowed.
